questions.question: Which of the following countries is completely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.fun_fact: Lesotho is one of only three sovereign nations in the world to be entirely enclaved by another country, alongside Vatican City and San Marino.

questions.question: What is the hardest naturally occurring mineral on the Mohs scale?
questions.fun_fact: Diamond sits at the absolute peak of the Mohs hardness scale with a rating of 10.

questions.question: The ancient city of Carthage, a major rival to the Roman Republic, was located in present-day which country?
questions.fun_fact: The ruins of Carthage are located just outside the modern Tunisian capital of Tunis.

questions.question: Which animated film features the fictional underwater city of Atlantis and was released by Disney in 2001?
options: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas
questions.fun_fact: Atlantis: The Lost Empire is noted for its distinct visual style inspired by comic book artist Mike Mignola.

questions.question: Umami, recognized as one of the five basic tastes, translates roughly from Japanese to mean what?
questions.fun_fact: The taste of umami is primarily triggered by the amino acid glutamate, which is abundant in fermented and aged foods.

questions.question: What unique physical adaptation do owls possess regarding the movement of their eyes?
options: They can move their eyes independently in all directions.
They have transparent eyelids for underwater vision.
They cannot move their eyes in their sockets and must turn their entire heads.
They possess three eyelids that blink vertically.
questions.fun_fact: Because their eyes are tube-shaped rather than spherical, owls can rotate their necks up to 270 degrees to compensate.

questions.question: In American football, how many points is a safety worth?
questions.fun_fact: A safety occurs when the ball carrier is tackled by the opposing team in their own end zone.

questions.question: What term is used in linguistics for words that sound similar in two languages and have the same meaning, often leading to false assumptions if they differ?
questions.fun_fact: Cognates share a common etymological origin, such as the English word 'night' and the German word 'Nacht'.

questions.question: Which spacecraft holds the record for being the farthest human-made object from Earth?
questions.fun_fact: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 has entered interstellar space and continues to transmit data back to Earth.

questions.question: Lake Baikal, the deepest and oldest freshwater lake in the world, is located in which country?
questions.fun_fact: Lake Baikal contains roughly 20 percent of the world's unfrozen surface freshwater.
